name: scribe-devtools
description: Developer tools in the scribe spirit: scripts instead of MCP servers, results on disk. browser-inspector (batch flows and an interactive session over playwright-core) and nx-angular-inspector (Nx project graph and Angular/Nx generators, no MCP server).

scripts.verify: oxfmt --check --disable-nested-config && oxlint --disable-nested-config && node scripts/check-pins.mjs && tsc --noEmit && node scripts/index-code.mjs --check && node scripts/check-instruction-sync.mjs --require-all && node scripts/check-claims.mjs
